items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pre-game; confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue.
items.why: Weekend injury summary optimism; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed official active.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; no major role shift for Adams or others.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary in Rams offense.

items.text: ETR listed Breece Hall as GTD/PESSIMISM; confirmed INACTIVE for Week 7.
items.why: Pessimistic GTD in weekend summary; Schefter listed among inactives (quad).
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevated for full workload vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share opens fully for committee mate.

items.text: ETR listed Saquon Barkley as EXPECTED TO PLAY; confirmed ACTIVE for MNF, post-game said hamstring came out great and back not an issue.
items.why: Weekend expected designation; Schefter/Rap confirmed active, postgame positive on hamstring/back.
items.implication: Full RB1 role continues; no immediate rest risk.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend summary (high ankle sprain context).
items.why: Missed third straight; high ankle confirmed in reports.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Ravens pass game downgrade.
items.opportunity: Rushing upside gone; WR/TE volume may shift.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (first game back) led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush share, 34% routes; Dobbins only 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Clear lead shares post-return over Dobbins/Harvey.
items.implication: Coleman upgrade to lead back; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitomizes high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (53rd EPA/play, last in YPC 3.1) yet fantasy RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume in red-zone/goal-line and targets override inefficiency.
items.implication: Sustainable RB1/2 floor despite poor efficiency metrics.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries + targets = high TD/reception ceiling.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 career games.
items.why: Clear route lead with Rice out (hamstring); historical ceiling note.
items.implication: Volume spike but efficiency/ceiling capped historically.
items.conflict: High routes vs career yardage ceiling under 83.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle (turned on purposeful slide) almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if actually injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide context; ETR watching list but Levitan optimistic.
items.implication: No expected miss or role change next week.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT per ETR weekend summary.
items.why: Listed OUT in summary; hamstring/other for Smith, related for Wicks.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned for MNF; targets consolidate elsewhere.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN (activated/expected) in ETR weekend summary; Schefter confirmed activation expected to play.
items.why: Activated and expected; weekend IN designation.
items.implication: Reclaims lead backfield role for Packers ROS.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
items.why: Call for more respect on production/role.
items.implication: Undervalued WR start/ROS consideration alongside Chase.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible in fantasy.
items.why: Big game explosion creates trade window.
items.implication: Capitalize on peak value before regression.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024 (limited).
items.why: Nico dominant route share; Dell limited return volume.
items.implication: Nico locked as clear WR1; Dell not immediate threat.
items.opportunity: 24 routes for Collins on limited dropbacks.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity; on ETR late watching list with Tracy.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-game; ETR listed hamstring.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential backup elevation if misses.
items.opportunity: If out, NYG RB snaps open.
